content.overview: Specialist instruction for donor-linked performance analysis & differential reasoning in donor/mother plant systems.

sections.title: Stratify before averaging
sections.body: Compare rooting, loss, time-to-root and abnormal outcomes by donor, batch, operator, zone and time point so a weak subgroup is not hidden by the facility average.

sections.title: Shared patterns and donor-linked patterns imply different next questions
sections.body: A decline across all donors after one room-control change supports investigating the shared process; a decline isolated to one donor group strengthens a source-linked hypothesis.

sections.title: Correlation is not diagnosis
sections.body: A donor-linked pattern identifies where to investigate, not proof of genotype, disease or handling as the cause.

commonMistakes: Treating visual health as proof of clean-stock status.
content.practicalApplication: Review a donor-management scenario, preserve identity and status evidence, and document the strongest supported next action without overstating cause or cleanliness.
content.summary: Donor management depends on traceable identity, plant-health evidence, controlled movement and longitudinal performance records.
